name: Corporate Finance Analyst
responsibilities: Run the annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting cycle: collect inputs, build the model, and defend the numbers to management
Advise on capital structure decisions (how much to raise, from where, and when) and support debt refinancing or restructuring work
Produce the variance analysis that explains why actuals missed budget and what to do about it, not just that they missed
skills: Building and maintaining a rolling forecast model that survives a changed assumption without breaking
Comparing actual vs. budget and turning the gap into a specific, explainable driver
Advising on financing decisions (capitalization amount, source, and timing) in language a non-finance stakeholder can act on
Preparing management-ready reports and dashboards on a fixed monthly or quarterly cadence
rawSkillPool: Advising on capitalization, sources, and timing
Business intelligence and data analysis software

evidence.quote: Financial Planning and Analysis Analyst; Treasury Analyst are recognized alternate titles for Financial and Investment Analysts (13-2051.00).
Advise clients on aspects of capitalization, such as amounts, sources, or timing. Confer with clients to restructure debt, refinance debt, or raise new debt.

evidence.title: Finance Controlling Intern
evidence.quote: Management Report & Presentation - to prepare standard report/dashboard to enable business performance to be reviewed on timely manners. Financial Planning Process - to participate in annual planning & quarterly forecast process, for both sales & expenses. Variance Analysis - to compare and analyze ACT vs BGT and highlight any areas of concern.
